shortDescription: Sends an email with the SendGrid API

options.name: api_key
options.description: Sendgrid API key to use instead of username/password.

options.name: attachments
options.description: A list of relative or explicit paths of files you want to attach (7MB limit as per SendGrid docs).

options.name: bcc
options.description: A list of email addresses to bcc.

options.name: cc
options.description: A list of email addresses to cc.

options.name: from_address
options.description: The address in the "from" field for the email.

options.name: from_name
options.description: The name you want to appear in the from field, for example V(John Doe).

options.name: headers
options.description: A dict to pass on as headers.

options.name: html_body
options.description: Whether the body is HTML content that should be rendered.

options.name: password
options.description: Password that corresponds to the username. It is only required if O(api_key) is not supplied.

options.name: subject
options.description: The desired subject for the email.

options.name: to_addresses
options.description: A list with one or more recipient email addresses.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for logging into the SendGrid account. It is only required if O(api_key) is not supplied.
